info.description: iFlytek Spark-X2.6-4B. The MaaS catalog says code, agent, long-text, and multilingual ability are improved and that three reasoning modes were added. Context is tagged 1M, with text input and text output. It prints an OpenAI base at /v2, an Anthropic base at /anthropic, and a complete Responses URL at /v1/responses; only that Responses path is recorded. The catalog marks the model limited-time free and lists a zero inference price, so the standard price is unset.

zh.description: 讯飞 Spark-X2.6-4B。星辰 MaaS 目录写明代码、智能体、长文本和多语言能力提升，并新增三档推理模式。上下文标为 1M，输入和输出都是文本。目录给出 OpenAI 基址 /v2、Anthropic 基址 /anthropic，以及完整的 Responses 地址 /v1/responses；这里只登记这条完整路径。目录角标为限时免费，推理价格为 0，因此标准价留空。

sources.title: 星辰 MaaS 模型目录（Spark-X2.6-4B）
